message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large red letters. The cover date is "EDISI 29 JULI-4 AGUSTUS 2013". Other text includes "THE ROLLING STONES: LAPORAN DARI LONDON" with a red lips logo, "MODUS CUCI UANG RUSLI ZAINAL", and the main headline "PERANG BINTANG DI BADAN ANTINARKOBA" in large white letters. 

The central image shows two muscular arms wearing tan uniforms, gripping a transparent plastic bag containing a white powder. The arm on the left has a shoulder patch with two yellow stars on a red and black background. The arm on the right has a shoulder patch with one yellow star. Both arms appear strained, with prominent veins and muscles, as they pull on the bag from opposite sides. Fine white powder is depicted puffing out from the top of the bag. The background is a grainy, dark blue-green texture. At the bottom right, there is a price of "RP 33.000", a website, "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", an ISSN number, and a barcode. A red border runs down the left and across the bottom of the image.
